app.name: FarmTwin
app.subtitle: Before you plant, see what would have happened, what makes sense today and what's coming.
app.offline: Offline: showing your last saved results

home.pastText: See how each rotation would have done over the last 20 years of real climate measured by NASA.
home.presentText: Ask FarmTwin with your voice and get a simple, data-backed explanation.
home.futureText: Your planting calendar with frost and heat alerts for your crops.
home.disclaimer: FarmTwin supports your decision; it does not replace your judgment or your local agronomist.
home.farmModeText: Your farm in 3D: plant plot by plot, play a real NASA year and earn medals.

explain.why.current: This is what you grow today: it's the baseline.
explain.why.bestWater: This rotation needs the least water on your field.
explain.why.bestIncome: This rotation has the highest expected income.
explain.why.bestSoil: This rotation takes the best care of your soil.
explain.why.balanced: It balances water, income and soil.
explain.evidence.power20y: 21 years of daily NASA POWER climate (2005–2025) at your field.
explain.evidence.et0: Water demand computed with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith and FAO crop coefficients.
explain.evidence.fusion: Climate adjusted to your field's real altitude (NASA SRTM terrain) by blending two NASA POWER cells.
explain.evidence.noFrost: In 21 years there were no days below these crops' frost threshold.
explain.evidence.frostYears: There were frost days during some crop's cycle.
explain.evidence.legumeN: Legumes fix nitrogen from the air into the soil.
explain.benefit.nitrogen: Adds nitrogen to the soil and reduces fertilizer.
explain.benefit.cover: Soil covered all year: less erosion.
explain.benefit.pestCycle: Switching crop families breaks pest cycles.
explain.benefit.baseline: Useful as a baseline for comparison.
explain.missing.waterAllocation: Your actual water allocation (AUTODEMA / water users' board).
explain.missing.prices: Up-to-date farm-gate prices (current values are estimates).
explain.missing.groundStation: Validation against a nearby SENAMHI station.
explain.review.waterShortage: Your water isn't enough: review the irrigation system or planted area.
explain.review.legumeVariety: Legume variety suited to the area.
explain.review.market: Buyers and prices for the cash crops.
explain.review.alfalfaAge: Age and condition of your alfalfa stand.
explain.review.sowingDates: Planting dates recommended by INIA for Majes.
explain.highlight.driestYear: {year}: the toughest year; it would have needed {extraM3ha} m³/ha more than usual.
explain.highlight.worstYear: {year}: the worst year; you would have earned S/ {lossPEN} less per hectare.
explain.highlight.problemYears: {count} of {total} years with problems (water or climate). Latest: {year}.

tiempo.title: Time machine
tiempo.subtitle: What would have happened to each rotation over the last 21 years of real climate measured by NASA?
tiempo.stripHint: Each row is a year and each square a month. Tap a row to travel to that year.
tiempo.ndviHint: Monthly NASA MODIS NDVI: greener means more active vegetation.

calendario.title: My calendar
calendario.subtitle: When you plant, how much water each week needs and what climate risks to expect, based on 21 years of NASA data.
calendario.bareNow: No crop in this rotation today: the field is bare.
calendario.waterWeek: Estimated irrigation for the next 7 days: {m3} m³/ha (average ET0 {et0} mm/day).
calendario.yearHint: Bars: each crop's cycle (lines mark its stages). Rows: weekly risk based on 2005–2025.
calendario.source: Source: NASA POWER 2005–2025, adjusted to your field's altitude (SRTM). Risk = share of years with that event in that week.
calendario.alertsText: Get a notification when your crops enter a week with frost or heat risk, or when harvest is near.

push.on: Alerts are on for this rotation.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications. On iPhone, add FarmTwin to your home screen first.
push.no-sw: Alerts work in the installed app or the published version (not in development mode).
push.not-configured: Alerts are not configured on the server yet.
push.denied: You blocked notifications. Enable them in your browser settings.
push.error: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

alerts.frostBody: In {p} of recent years there was frost in these weeks. Your crop is in {stage}: check how to protect it.
alerts.heatBody: In {p} of recent years there was extreme heat in these weeks ({stage}). Adjust irrigation.
alerts.harvestBody: About {days} days left. Plan the harvest and the next crop in your rotation.
alerts.waterBody: Estimated irrigation: {m3} m³/ha over 7 days (ET0 {et0} mm/day, NASA POWER). No frost or heat risk.
alerts.bareBody: Good time to prepare the soil or plant a cover crop.

granja.title: Farm mode
granja.zoneHint: Tap your area on the map, choose your farm size and build your farm.
granja.yearHint: Pick a real year measured by NASA (🌵 driest, ❄️ frost, 🔥 heat):
granja.palette: Choose what to plant and tap the plots
granja.paletteHint: Values per hectare per year (2005–2025 median). All plots share the same reservoir.

event.dry: 🌵 The reservoir is empty! {n} plots are drying out.
event.climate_risk: ❄️ Extreme weather this month on {n} plots (NASA POWER data).
event.water_stress: 🌡️ High-demand month: {n} plots need more than your monthly share.

granja.goalsHint: Play the full year to earn the medals.
granja.resultHint: Compared with planting alfalfa on all your {ha} ha, with the same real weather.
granja.source: Climate: NASA POWER + SRTM. Water and money per plot = FAO-56 engine result × area. Baseline: {base}.

tutorial.title: Welcome to your farm!
tutorial.paint: Pick a rotation in the palette and tap plots to plant it. All plots share the reservoir's water.
tutorial.year: Choose a real year measured by NASA, e.g. 🌵 the driest.
tutorial.play: Press ▶ Play the year: watch crops grow, water drop and earn medals.
